annotations.title: Convert Guitar Tab to Piano Notes

description: Read six-string ASCII guitar tab in standard tuning and return the sounding pitches as piano notes, in the order they appear. Returns events (column position, MIDI numbers, and the string and fret behind each note), warnings, and a link to the browser converter. Tab spacing carries no rhythm, so durations are never inferred. No Guitar Pro files or audio.

capo.description: Capo fret; every note sounds this many semitones higher. 0 means no capo.

tab.description: Plain-text tab with six lines from high e to low E, for example "e|--0--|" on the first line. Several tab blocks may follow each other.

name: tab_to_piano_notes

browserTool.description: Link to the matching free browser tool on clefdrills.com, to share with the user.

events.description: One entry per tab column that has notes: index, block, column, midis, and sources (string, fret, midi).

warnings.description: Limits the user should know, such as missing rhythm.

title: Convert Guitar Tab to Piano Notes
